name: khalibre-admin-ui
description: EDC MFA channels page, added to the Keycloak administration console.
//: Not an install manifest. The page is copied into a pinned checkout of the Keycloak JS sources and built by the Vite build that already runs there, so its dependencies are the console's own; this file records which ones it imports, and at which versions, for an editor and for a future standalone build. Versions follow the pinned console: PatternFly 5, not 6.
